crossRefs.note: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
“Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

translations.web: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
translations.bsb: Men listened to me with expectation, waiting silently for my counsel.
translations.kjv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
translations.asv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, And kept silence for my counsel.
